# golimumab

Golimumab (BOHJ18A4) is one of six biologic therapies included in the BMSL treatment monitoring program.

## Mentions

- Page 11: "BMSL omfatter i denne årsrapport behandling med infliximab (BOHJ18A1), adalimumab (BOHJ18A3), golimumab (BOHJ18A4), ustekinumab (BOHJ18B3), vedolizumab (BOHJ19H4) og tofacitinib (BOHJ28D)" [^src1]
- Page 25: "BOHJ18A4 - Behandling med golimumab # (0) 1.126 (2)" [^src2]
- Page 43: "BOHJ18A4 - Behandling med golimumab 10 (0) 1.063 (2)" [^src3]
